subject.title: Discord thread reply after session done: silent message loss due to session-store CAS race, no retry unlike Telegram

question: Should this Discord report be resolved by landing and retesting the shared self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, or should Discord also require channel-level retry/requeue or visible-failure parity for reply-session-init conflicts before closure?
rationale: Current source shows both a shared session CAS conflict and Discord-specific non-retry handling, while the open candidate fix changes the shared session lifecycle boundary rather than the Discord channel path.

options.title: Review Shared Self-Heal First
options.body: Treat the open shared self-heal PR as the primary fix path, then validate Discord thread follow-ups before adding a channel-specific retry loop.

options.title: Require Discord Retry Parity Now
options.body: Queue a separate Discord repair that classifies reply-session-init conflicts as retryable and preserves or visibly fails the inbound message independent of the shared PR.

options.title: Ask For Live Discord Proof First
options.body: Keep the issue open and request a current-main Discord thread timing repro before choosing between shared recovery and channel-level retry.

recommendation.title: Review Shared Self-Heal First
recommendation.body: Treat the open shared self-heal PR as the primary fix path, then validate Discord thread follow-ups before adding a channel-specific retry loop.

likelyOwner.reason: `jalehman` has the strongest recent history on the guarded reply-session initialization and session-accessor boundary where the shared-vs-channel recovery decision sits.
